status: registered before the E8b run, after E8 (MS-159) results
motivation: MS-159: EarthDial separates event/non-event pairs with the two-image question (d .365) but not with the one-image question (d_post .036). The two questions differ in wording, so the contrast mixes image content and question wording. E8b keeps the SAME two-image question and changes only the image pair.
code: code/e8b_pair_controls_v0.py wrapping unchanged code/e8_earthdial_protocol_v0.py (sha256 529d1422...); same model, runtime, template, decoding and items as E8

arms.pair_post_post: [post, post] of each item: no change between the images

primary_subset: 192 tiles shared with E0 (as in MS-159); 203 tiles reported as secondary

metrics.compare: on positive items (dates spanning the landslide), P(yes | real [pre, post]) - P(yes | [post, post]), paired tile bootstrap 2000
metrics.direction: on positive items, P(yes | real) - P(yes | [post, pre]), paired tile bootstrap

verdict.invalid_run: real-arm reproduction vs E8 < 0.95, or parse failure > 10% in any arm
verdict.compares_pair: compare >= 0.10 and CI lower > 0 (answers depend on the pair, not only on a scar in the second image)
verdict.direction_sensitive: direction >= 0.10 and CI lower > 0; otherwise direction_blind_or_unclear (reported alongside)

what_this_does_not_show: change understanding in general (one model, zero-shot, RGB renders, exposed hiroshima-heavy tiles)
why a pair is needed (could be a difference detector)
